data.name: Putt-Putt® and Pep's Dog on a Stick
data.detailed_description:
Humongous Tees Now Available!

Official Humongous Entertainment T-shirts featuring Pajama Sam, Spy Fox, Freddi Fish, and Putt-Putt are now available on Amazon.


Acerca do jogo

Jump in and help Pep collect all of the goodies before his rivals catch him!

Oil slicks, trampolines and teleporters can make Pep's journey even more unpredictable! Pep's quick with his hoppin' stick, but he'll really need to push his pace to hop from one challenging level to the next. Pigs with jet packs, bouncing bears and leaping frogs, what will Pep face next?

  • Challenging, arcade-style games for kids ages 3 to 8 (and children of all ages)
  • Brand new action with all the quality you'd expect from Humongous Entertainment
  • Save your game after each level and track the scores of up to 75 players
  • Over 100 levels of hound-hopping fun

Junior Arcade games are jam packed with fast-and-furious game-play that satisfies kids' hunger for action and surprises! Starring lovable characters and the high-quality, hand-drawn animation that families have come to expect from Humongous Entertainment, this series will provide hours of action and fun for your children.

This product uses ScummVM across Windows, Mac and Linux which is released under the GNU GPL v2.

reviews.review:
Why do I love Putt-Putt® and Pep's Dog on a Stick so much? It's pretty simple when I think about it. Putt-Putt® and Pep's Dog on a Stick isn't just the best game on Steam, it might just be the greatest form of entertainment of all time. Just imagine it riding through the sandy beach, the wind in its hair, its mighty pogo stick below him. As it rides through the red mountains, the ladies swoon at its very theme song. They know how it sounds. The essence of its msic is sold in Morocco under the name of "Putt-Putt Orgasm." The very nature of Putt-Putt® and Pep's Dog on a Stick is mystery. Could it be playing a deeper game than even its creator realizes? The answer is yes; it has transcended such boundaries as the digital world, and has free will to do whatever it sees fit. However, Putt-Putt® and Pep's Dog on a Stick is filled with such guile, such arcane craft that it does not even use these powers. 

Why, you might ask? You will never know, for the mind of the Putt-Putt® and Pep's Dog on a Stick is not one that is easily penetrated. Putt-Putt® and Pep's Dog on a Stick is such a force of nature in  its realm that nothing can truly touch it, the only thing keeping him bound to the world of the PC at all is its will to exist within the preordained boundaries of its world. Putt-Putt® and Pep's Dog on a Stick  is not only beyond the comprehension of us, it exists within a plane of true focus and beauty. Observe its playful smile, its gorgeous and rippling biceps, its gallant nose, and most importantly, its eyes. Those eyes, like pools of zeroes and ones, provide the only glimpse into the true machinations of Putt-Putt® and Pep's Dog on a Stick. Do not stare into them. Many good men have gone mad in the attempt. Putt-Putt® and Pep's Dog on a Stick is not just a video game,  a formless collection needed to test how magnets apply on a hard drive; it is the binding that holds the saga of life together. Without Putt-Putt® and Pep's Dog on a Stick, the entire Steam Community, the entire world of as we know it crumbles. The Nile would stop flowing without Putt-Putt® and Pep's Dog on a Stick, the Ocean would dry up, and the Icebergs would melt without its frosty gaze.
